Explanation: Creates a new input set. It describes no input until you set one.
Makes the input set describe a key on the keyboard. The keys are constants in KeyboardEvent.
Makes the input set describe a mouse button. The buttons are constants in MouseEvent.
Creates a new input table with nothing in it.
Runs the behavior whenever the input in the input set happens.
Names the input table. Items whose input group matches this name use the table.
Returns the game's default input table.
Adds an input table to the game so it can be used.
Sets which input table an item uses when it has the focus.
Chooses when the behavior runs: BEGIN, CONTINUE, FINISH or FINISH_UNCAUGHT.
Requires a modifier key, such as SHIFT, CONTROL, ALT or META, to be held down.
Requires the input to happen this many times in a row.
